title: Request specs are rejected with 403 by HostAuthorization, silently disabling the request-spec suite
evidence: config/application.rb appended .pi216.ai to config.hosts in EVERY environment. In the test environment that turns Rails permissive default into a one-entry allowlist, so any request spec using the default host (www.example.com) is rejected with 403 by ActionDispatch::HostAuthorization before it reaches the app. Observed 2026-09-19 21:4x UTC: spec/requests/scheduling_posts_spec.rb -> 7 failures, all Host Authorization (a 403 and the Rails exception page containing the Host Authorization guide). Pre-existing from the initial commit, unrelated to the caption work shipped in the same run.

notes.note: FIXED same run: config/application.rb now appends .pi216.ai unless Rails.env.test?, so the test environment keeps its permissive default and production is untouched. Verified: bundle exec rspec spec/requests/scheduling_posts_spec.rb -> 7 examples, 0 failures (was 7 failures). The request-spec suite can catch regressions again.
